note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2): every figure acts out its word's new hook (sound cue + meaning). A white pillar splits the kitchen: feminine words left, masculine words and adjectives right. One box per item.

items.label: la menthe
items.scene: My AUNT (m'AHNT) in a flowery hat sniffs a big pot of fresh MINT on the windowsill.

items.label: la soupe
items.scene: Same as English 'soup' (said SOOP): a grandmother ladles steaming SOUP into a big blue bowl.

items.label: la sauce
items.scene: Same as English 'sauce' (said SOHS): a hedgehog tips a sauce-boat of glossy brown SAUCE over a fish.

items.label: l'amertume
items.scene: A MARE clutches her TUM (ah-mehr-TEWM) after biting a lemon, pulling a face at its BITTERNESS.

items.label: la préparation
items.scene: Same as English 'preparation' (said pray-pah-rah-SYOHN): a teenage apprentice lines up chopped vegetables in little bowls, the PREPARATION before cooking.

items.label: la recette
items.scene: A girl presses the red RESET knob (ruh-SEHT) on the oven and starts her RECIPE card all over again.

items.label: la saveur
items.scene: A cook savours ("sa-VUR") the FLAVOUR of her soup with a spoon.

items.label: la frite
items.scene: A FLEET (FREET) of little paper boats sails along the counter, each loaded with golden FRIES.

items.label: le goût
items.scene: A little girl licks a spoonful of sticky purple GOO and smacks her lips: what a TASTE!

items.label: délicieux
items.scene: A boy waves his DAILY calendar, calling 'see ya!' (day-lee-SYEUH), as he bites into a DELICIOUS cream tart.

items.label: grillé
items.scene: A GREEN parrot cheers 'YAY!' (gree-YAY) over a GRILLED sausage striped with black bars.

items.label: culinaire
items.scene: A COOL cat in sunglasses stands NEAR the stove (kew-lee-NEHR) holding a golden whisk, a CULINARY prize.

items.label: le cuisinier
items.scene: A COOK so QUEASY he has turned green all over props his bandaged KNEE on a stool (kwee-zee-NYAY) while stirring his pot.

items.label: le haricot
items.scene: A shaggy HAIRY COW (ah-ree-KOH) munches a long green BEAN from a colander.
